title: Make a sentence diagram
subtitle: Display relationships without forcing a premature translation.
overview: A sentence diagram is a reading aid: it makes the main assertion, clauses, phrases, and non-finite forms visibly related.
Diagram for accuracy, not beauty. Every line should answer a question of attachment or function.

sections.title: Diagram labels
rows: Point a participle or phrase to its controller.

items.grc: ὁ θεὸς ὁ πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει συνεζωοποίησεν ἡμᾶς τῷ Χριστῷ.
items.en: Main verb: made alive; subject: God; participial description: being rich in mercy.

items.grc: ἵνα ἐνδείξηται τὸν πλοῦτον τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ.
items.en: Purpose clause: so that he might show the wealth of his grace.
